bands.name: pale stone plum
bands.line: 16 parts Titanium White : 1 part Quinacridone Magenta : 2 parts Mars Black

bands.name: deep plum lobe
bands.line: 2 parts Titanium White : 5 parts Cadmium Red : 8 parts Ultramarine Blue

bands.name: plum
bands.line: 5 parts Titanium White : 4 parts Quinacridone Magenta : 5 parts Mars Black

bands.name: dusty taupe plum
bands.line: 7 parts Titanium White : 1 part Quinacridone Magenta : 4 parts Mars Black

bands.name: dark plum pit
bands.line: 3 parts Burnt Sienna : 1 part Quinacridone Magenta : 4 parts Ultramarine Blue

guide.overview: Build all five rounded hollows first in white paste and let cure hard, then paint color dark-to-light. That lets the pale background lap cleanly around the interlocked curves arcing from the upper left.

steps.title: Prepare the canvas and mark the bands
do: Sketch three large arcs nesting around upper left corner.
Mark central winding band mid-left to lower center, right-mid field, small pit at lower right edge.
Leave rest open as pale stone plum background.

steps.title: Lay the thick paste
do: Trowel white paste heavy over all five marked zones.
Model rounded hollow rims with knife edge, keep surface full.
Leave 2-3 days until bone-hard.

steps.title: Paint dark plum pit
do: Cover small rounded pit at lower right edge.
Lay heavy color with flat blade in one direction.
Cut clean outer rim at canvas edge.

steps.title: Paint deep plum lobe
do: Cover large rounded lobe in upper left.
Spread heavy coat over cured dome, following curve.
Keep rim proud and rounded.

steps.title: Paint plum
do: Fill winding central shape mid-left to lower center.
Lay heavy coat edge-to-edge over paste.
Butt upper curve tight to deep lobe.

steps.title: Paint dusty taupe plum
do: Fill rounded field on right mid.
Lay heavy cover in broad side strokes.
Close seam to central plum on left.

steps.title: Paint pale stone plum
do: Flood remaining background around all four shapes.
Lay heavy coat to canvas edges, filling gaps.
Tuck tight to each curved rim with knife tip.

steps.title: Let it dry and finish
do: Inspect hollows from side for missed white spots.
Sharpen any slurred curves with clean knife tip.
Dry flat, varnish only when fully cured.

qa.question: what to do if the plum color is coming too dark?
qa.answer: Leave the mix alone and do not add anything yet. I can not tell true darkness from this photo because light shifts it. Your last Color mixes reading for Dark Aubergine was darker and duller than planned but it was flagged as unreliable, so sort out what it flagged and check it again on white paper.

mix.advice: Mix in about 2 parts Quinacridone Magenta and 1 part Ultramarine Blue to 10 parts of it.
